intro: A handful of fried peanuts (30 g) has about 170 kcal. Most of the calories come from fat, both the peanut's natural oil and the frying oil.
diet: Yes, peanuts have protein and fat that keep you full longer. But they're calorie-dense, so a small handful is enough. The problem is eating straight from the jar in front of the TV. Portion them into a small container first.
tips: Fill a small 30 g container (about a handful) for your office snack, don't bring the whole jar.
Choose boiled or roasted peanuts when you can, they have less oil.
Sprinkle a few peanuts over veggies or salad for flavour, instead of eating them as a separate snack.

swap.name: 1 handful of boiled peanuts
swap.why: Boiled peanuts use no oil and have more water, so fewer calories while still being just as filling.

faq.a: They do have protein, about 7 g per handful. But they have more fat, so don't make them your main protein source.

faq.q: Boiled or fried peanuts, which is healthier?
faq.a: Boiled peanuts are lower in calories and oil. Fried peanuts are crunchier but more energy-dense.
